settings.title: MyoLift App Membership
settings.content: The difference between the MyoLift QT+ Base and Premium memberships is reflected in the MyoLift Smart App experience. With the Base Membership, you receive a 30-day free trial to all Premium app features. After the trial ends, the Base Membership provides access to App-Free Mode and My QT Plan only. Most treatment options within the “Sessions”menu will be locked, as these are part of the Premium features. The Premium Membership unlocks full access to all guided treatments, advanced sessions, and app features designed to maximize your MyoLift results

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Step 1: Clarify – Cleanse with the Mangosteen Cleanser to remove impurities and balance the skin.
Step 2: Hydrate – Mist with the RePlenish Spritzer to prep skin for microcurrent absorption.
Step 3: Treat – Choose the treatment method for the day:

  • Sheet Mask: Days 1, 8, 14
  • QT Probes: Days 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13
  • Jowl & Lip Masks with Splitter: Days 3, 5, 10, 12
    Step 4: Nourish – Apply ReVital C Serum to brighten, firm, and seal in your glow.

Note: Steps 1, 2, and 4 are consistent every day. Step 3 alternates per the schedule above to ensure comprehensive treatment coverage.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Can I use this kit without the MyoLift microcurrent device?
settings.text1: The products can be used independently, but they’re formulated to deliver optimal results when paired with microcurrent therapy.
settings.title2: How long does this 10-piece kit last?
settings.text2: When used as directed (14-day protocol), the core items should last beyond the program, while sheet masks and treatments are portioned for the full 2-week cycle.
settings.title3: What makes this kit effective for brightening and firming?
settings.text3: It combines antioxidants like Vitamin C and CoQ10 with peptides and mangosteen to support collagen production, elasticity, and skin tone.
settings.title4: Is this kit safe for sensitive skin?
settings.text4: Yes. The ingredients are chosen for their gentle and restorative properties. Always patch-test first if you have highly reactive skin.
settings.title5: Do I need to follow the exact treatment schedule?
settings.text5: Following the suggested protocol helps target different areas of concern evenly over 14 days, but you can adjust based on your skincare needs and comfort.
settings.title6: Is this kit good for mature skin?
settings.text6: Absolutely. It’s ideal for those noticing early signs of aging and wanting to improve firmness, texture, and brightness.
